issues.note: Left as recorded: the piece keeps its own kind and position, and no wording or punctuation is invented to settle it.

layout.note: All 84 sources are placed once, in order: 42 output rows, 41 of them carrying Arabic and Persian together. Piece lengths run 43 code points at the median, inside the manual-v1 range. 1 inserted space across 1 original row boundary is decided separately above, each accepted as the minimal correction where a boundary cut a sentence. Rows were checked against the source in sampled groups by genre, and every item against the corpus-wide statistics.

spacing_review.reason: Separate words at the original row boundary
spacing_review.note: Accepted: the single U+0020 sits between «وَكُلَّ» and «شَيْءٍ أَحْص» at destination offset 7, where the original row boundary cut a sentence (r00031 to r00032). Both retained slices stay byte-identical; no other character is added or removed.
